note: First-floor robot workshop of the B61 half-timbered repair café: teal-painted brick between dark oak roof beams, deep-blue floorboards, a skylight and an iron pendant lamp. LANDMARK: the big round clock-face window with iron spokes. The open doorway on the left goes back into the attic (sloping beams visible), the way back; this is the last room. The mature word infidèle appears only as museum wall text on the blank framed plaque. Adjectives have no gender (divider null). Zoom: the navy electrics bench on the right (z1).
